name: Egyptian residential building benchmark models
description: A set of benchmark models developed to represent typical energy use in the Egyptian residential buildings sector for evaluation and policy analysis.
evaluation_method: RMSE / MAE / MAPE (energy consumption prediction error)
notes: Non-ML benchmark of archetype building models for simulation and policy analysis; not a large-scale ML dataset. Results depend on modelling assumptions; limited risk of ML contamination but limited representativeness of current building stocks.
